onset.Description: Event onset relative to recording start.

eventnumber.Description: Sequential event index within the run (0-based).

objectnumber.Description: Concept index in the THINGS database (1-1854).

stim.Description: Path of the stimulus image relative to the dataset root, e.g. 'stimuli/carousel/carousel_11s.jpg'. Forward slashes. The image archive is provided separately under the THINGS license.

stimname.Description: Bare filename of the stimulus image.

blocksequencenumber.Description: Sequence index within the current block.

stimnumber.Description: Image instance index within the concept (1-12).

isteststim.Description: 1 if the trial belongs to the held-out validation set, else 0.

teststimnumber.Description: Index in the validation image set (0-199), or -1 for non-test trials.

Levels.1: Catch target requiring a button press.

rt.Description: Reaction time relative to last target event.

correct.Description: 1 if the participant correctly identified the catch target, else 0.

time_stimon.Description: Stimulus on-time measured by the experimental software (independent clock).

time_stimoff.Description: Stimulus off-time measured by the experimental software (independent clock).
